text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the new year, having raced through 
her Senior year, Shinko Windy achieved her 
long-cherished wish and stood at the 
ceremony for that very award—!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the broadcast has started. When it 
comes to the dirt division, it's gotta 
be—!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
――The "Best Dirt Umamusume" award goes to 
Shinko Windy-san! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Shinko Windy, she became quite 
a topic in the Classic Class as the 
"Biting Umamusume," but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Warm laughter ripples through the crowd 
like gentle waves. Though it was quite an 
ordeal back then, that incident has now 
become one of the endearing “legends” she 
created.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
—Her performance last year was remarkable, 
and her abilities are recognized by 
everyone. The press votes clearly 
reflected that as well...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has acknowledged her strength. 
That fact alone brings me great joy.
choice_data_list: (Even so, my mind is already made up.)

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
――And now, Shinko Windy. A few words on 
receiving this award――

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Stooop!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoooo... said anything about "receiving" 
it, hmmm~~~?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan is... Windy-chan is, you 
know...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I don't need something like thaaat~~!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeehhh――?!

text_block_list.name: Living Room Viewer
text_block_list.text: Pfffffffft-!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! Check your phone! The URA 
livestream...! Something crazy is going 
on!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa-wa! W-Windy-chan...?!?!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
“—N-No way! Why would she say that...?! 
What does she mean, she doesn't need 
it...?”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugaaaah! Silence, I say!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "...Listen up! Hear me well!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Windy-chan's greatness can't be 
measured by silly awards and things!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Because... knowing that Windy-chan is 
strong and awesome means—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the world knows it full well 
by now, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying that an award isn't 
even necessary at this point!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even if we don't get an award, everyyyone 
will pass down our story on their own! 
Even 100 years from now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan is fine with that... No.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"*That's* what's good! That's... what it 
really means to 'get noticed'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Attention is something born when the 
feelings and thoughts of individuals 
naturally gather as one... And wanting 
that is why she has been running."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's why she doesn't need attention 
directed at her just because 'someone 
decided she won an award'..."

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"—Ain't that the truth...! That girl's 
strength is the real deal."

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh... That troublemaking Umamusume 
again? Whoa, the site's getting slammed 
with traffic...!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa...! But I think I get it. What that 
girl's trying to say..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's why... I decline!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna withdraw-noda~~~!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Goodness... To think you were considering 
such a thing...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fufun, surprised? ...And so, that's why!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You guys! And you watching the broadcast 
too! Remember this: "There's a baaad 
Umamusume who rejected her award!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, that's the end of this 
conversation!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Run for it!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
...Hahaha... hahahaha! I see... She really 
is an interesting girl. She's done it 
again, hasn't she...!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Uh, as you can hear, everyone. This is 
quite an unexpected development... Um, 
err...!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
...And so, for this year's URA Dirt 
Division Award, the result is... 'No 
Umamusume Selected'!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
S-Seriously...?! She's that strong on top 
of having such an intense personality, so 
there's really nothing left to say...!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Ahahaha...! No way...! Just how 
much are you trying to surprise me?

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... "Attention", huh... Everyone wants 
it when they're kids. But gradually, 
people give up on that...

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
I realized that "I'm just an ordinary 
person, and no one's watching me that 
closely"... you know? And yet...

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: So you were different, weren't you—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyahahahahahaha!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I chased frantically after the sprinting 
Shinko Windy. Before long, the suspense 
turned to fun... and before I knew it, I 
was laughing out loud too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Ahahaha... Phew~~, did you see 
the looks on their faces...?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Upupu, you've got a funny face too♪
choice_data_list: Oh no, I've really done it now...!
Oops, I went and did it...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Aha! I did it...! The prank was a huge 
success!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy rejoices with sheer delight. 
A strange sense of accomplishment filled 
the air—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Kufufufu... It is truly... 
incredible...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
To be able to do... something like this... 
Unbelievable...! As expected of 
Windy-chan, nanoda...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh... Hey, minion.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember that time Windy-chan 
messed up...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The unforgettable 'Biting Incident.' From 
that moment on, her racing life changed 
dramatically."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if she brought it upon herself, it's 
not hard to imagine the immense stress she 
suffered from the public backlash..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she kept on running. Believing 
that someday, things would change...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely refuse to let things end 
like this. With fierce determination... 
holding onto that...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...We managed to overturn it all, didn't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's not even the half of it... 
Everyone's paying super close attention to 
Windy-chan's strength...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"And now, Windy-chan's terrifying infamy 
is echoing all across Japan!!"
choice_data_list:
With today's prank, make an even bigger 
splash!

With today's prank, you'll make an even 
bigger splash, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! This is a major historic event in 
the racing world!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugaaaaaahhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yay, yay! We pulled it offfff!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan and you are the best, the 
scaaaaariest baddies around...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ――Aaahhhhh....!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: All that struggling... was worth it...!
choice_data_list: You really... gave it your all.
You really... gave it your all.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...! You did great too! You kept up 
nicely!
choice_data_list: I was able to keep up because it was you.

I was able to come this far because it was 
you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Is Windy-chan a good boss?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nishishishi! That's what I like to hear♪ 
You'd better keep following me forever and 
ever!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan wants way, waaaay more 
attention, and..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"If I want to be talked about for 
generations to come, this much success 
isn't gonna cut it!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun...♪ Nooow then, how should I 
surprise the world next...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Minion! Right off the bat, got any good 
ideas?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan wants to do something even 
bigger than what we did today!"
choice_data_list: Alright, time for a strategy meeting!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's her... I felt that no matter what 
failures or obstacles she faces down the 
road, she'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She will overturn and rewrite any 
adversity. Today surpasses yesterday, 
tomorrow surpasses today— she will create 
a legend no one else can imitate...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And one day, I will fulfill my ambition. A 
hundred years from now, surely—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll be remembered as the undisputed top 
of the all-time greatest Umamusume 
rankings—!
